limits: The original native009 aggregate remains NOT_ACCEPTED; earlier failed attempts remain unchanged. This separate acceptance covers the measured core only.

The generic MCP wrapper still says input release incomplete for this known settings rejection; last_error retains the rejection while the session remains running. Unrelated errors must follow normal cleanup/recovery guidance.

No native 32-bit OS, i686 GUI-connected workflow, arbitrary application/hardware, desktop-wide/same-process isolation, distribution, global foreground noninterference, historical GUI-stall fix, or complete Ultra parity claim.
